target.body:
## Summary
- freeze and sanitize one SQLite image before any remote mutation, then use its SHA-256 for D1 and R2 identity
- publish all nine Gitcrawl cloud-v2 datasets with rotating mutation tokens, complete coverage activation, and explicit cutover
- fail closed on stale or incomplete revisions, fingerprints, summaries, clusters, and PR hydration unless explicitly overridden
- strip raw JSON, patches, blobs, local source indexes, and private local paths before bundle hashing
- consume CrawlKit snapshot provenance and immutable bundle-key support from openclaw/crawlkit#50

## Tests
- `GOWORK=off go mod tidy`
- `GOWORK=off go vet ./...`
- `GOWORK=off go test ./... -count=1`
- `GOWORK=off go test -race ./internal/cli ./internal/store -count=1`

## Dependencies
- https://github.com/openclaw/crawlkit/pull/50
- https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/36
